title: Close the roller clamp on an IV line left running free: roll its wheel to the stop without sliding the clamp on the line
instruction: Close the roller clamp on this IV line.
context: Nurses close a gravity set's roller clamp at every prime, bag change and stop (O*NET 29-1141 Registered Nurses, 3.47 million: 'Administer medications'; 29-2061 LPNs, 0.67 million: 'start intravenous fluids'). An open clamp is free flow to the patient. The 6 g clamp lies loose on soft tubing: push its 12 mm wheel without holding the body and the clamp slides along the line, or drags the line, instead of closing.
setup: Positions (x forward from the arm bases, y left) in cm; heights above the table top (74.75 cm). Fixed: a steel IV pole (SimReady IV_pole_a01, 1.8 m) on the floor at (45, 74) beside the table's left edge; on its hook a 1 L saline bag (PVC film, 13.6 x 4.4 x 25 cm, bottom seam 72 cm up) with its spike and a 2.1 x 6 cm drip chamber whose outlet is at (45, 55.6), 58.8 cm up. Fixed: an IV training forearm (skin-coloured vinyl, 32 cm long from wrist x 37 to elbow end x 69, 6.2 to 9.4 cm wide, 4.2 to 8.2 cm high) along x at y -24.5, left hand palm down, fingers toward the arms to x 20; a pink 20 G cannula on its back at x 44 to 46 under a 5 x 3.2 cm clear film dressing, a 1.2 x 4 cm tape strip over the set's luer at x 43, 5.8 cm up. Primed set tubing: PVC, 3.0 mm ID x 4.1 mm OD, 15 g/m full of saline. The upstream section (114 cm) hangs from the chamber outlet to the table at about (42, 52), runs across the table and arrives along -y at the clamp's head at (30, 2.7). The patient section (37.4 cm, 26.4 cm straight end to end) leaves the clamp's tail at (30, -2.7), runs along -y to (30, -9), in an S out to (26.8, -15) and back to (37.5, -18.3), up the forearm's side and along its back to the cannula's luer. Roller clamp, loose on the table, wheel up, centred at (29.6, 0.1), long axis along y (head +y), turned -8 degrees as the line settles: white polypropylene body 54 x 18 x 10 mm, 3 mm walls, 2 mm floor that ramps up 3.4 mm under the wheel's track, grip ridges on the walls at the tail; blue ribbed polypropylene wheel 12 mm across, 9 mm wide, wide open at the head end of its 22 mm track. Clamp 6 g in all. Distractors, SimReady, loose, ignored by scoring: a blue plastic cup (dishware_plastic_cup_a01, 6.4 cm across, 10 cm tall, 20 g) at (56, -6); a white box of bandages (bandage_medical_a01, 4.9 x 5.2 x 4.2 cm, 16 g) at (17, 12); a box of examination gloves (box_glove_a01, 17.8 x 11.7 x 5.6 cm, 450 g) at (64, -42), turned -17 degrees.
scoring: Read from the wheel's position along its track (real trial: a photo of the wheel against its moulded stop, ruler in view), a pen mark on the tubing at the clamp's tail, and video of the hands and line. The whole run scores 0 if at any time either tubing section is pulled to within 1.5 cm of straight (end-to-end distance at least its length minus 1.5 cm: 37.4 cm patient section, 114.2 cm upstream section), or the clamp is slid 4 cm or more along its tubing from where it started. Otherwise, judged at the end: if any gripper fingertip is within 2 cm of the clamp or of any tubing, or the clamp, wheel or tubing has not been at rest for the last 1 s (clamp under 1 cm/s, every tubing point under 2 cm/s, wheel and slide changing under 0.2 mm per step), the score is 0. With hands clear and at rest: 1.0 if the wheel is within 0.5 mm of its narrow stop (21.5 mm or more of its 22 mm travel) and that, the hands clear and the rest have held together for 3 s; 0.4 if the wheel has travelled 13.2 mm (60 percent) or more but is not yet closed or not yet held for 3 s; 0 otherwise.
reset_notes: Wheel back at the head end of its track, the clamp back where the tubing's pen mark shows, the line laid out as in the setup. Nothing is consumed. No seed changes the scene.
fidelity: PhysX rigid bodies. Clamp body, ramp and wheel are primitives; the wheel slides on a prismatic joint (it does not roll) against 3 N joint friction. The open clamp's grip on its tubing is a hidden slider with 1.5 N friction (an estimate) that both tubing sections are fixed to; their end links ignore the clamp body's colliders. Tubing: 2.5 cm capsule links, bend springs, no stretch, no fluid or flow, so closure is read from the wheel. Forearm, cannula, bag and drip chamber: fixed custom meshes.
